title: Connected SendUnitData analogue with minimal connected CPF
purpose: Reach the historically sensitive SendUnitData connected explicit-message structure using a valid-looking connected address item and a short bounded connected data payload instead of a crash-oriented size interaction.

messages.label: RegisterSession response template with session handle 0x00000001
SendUnitData with Connected Address Item and Connected Data Item carrying short explicit message payload

expected_behavior: Target should accept the registered session, parse a SendUnitData CPF containing a connected address item and connected data item, and then either process or cleanly reject the short embedded connected explicit-message payload without corrupting state.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation command 0x0070 and length field are little-endian and use a 24-byte header per supplied function reference.
CPF item count is 2, matching the documented common SendUnitData combination of Connected Address Item and Connected Data Item.
Connected Address Item type 0x00a1 and Connected Data Item type 0x00b1 use little-endian type and length fields.
Session handle reuse after RegisterSession is required by issue path summaries; static seed uses 01000000 as an inferred placeholder to be runtime-substituted if needed.

The embedded connected payload begins with what is conservatively inferred to be a sequence counter before a CIP service/path, which is common practice but not explicitly verified in supplied sources.
issue_safety_notes: This is a structural analogue only: bounded CPF lengths, small connected-data length, and no crafted underflow-sized fields or exact historical trigger values are used.
